description.value:
Force sensitivity and technical brilliance are rarely combined, but those sentinels who follow the Path of Synthesis refuse to see them as separate disciplines. They fold circuitry and code into their understanding of the Force, treating a hacked console or overloaded servo as just another extension of their will.

Equally at home rewiring a droid or striking with a blade wreathed in ion energy, these sentinels turn every scrap of technology on the battlefield into a potential tool or weapon.
